# möbius for macOS 0.3.0

- Each Bot has a persistent conversation above the chat list. Open its avatar to
  ask about other chats, manage routines and receive updates from its saved hooks.
- The conversation has a compact centered Bot header. Avatar status shows when the
  Bot is running, awaiting approval or has unread messages. File attachments work
  without choosing a project.
- Routine editing preserves saved event triggers and additional timers. Pause,
  resume and stop use the same routine commands as the Bot.
- Bots have seven face shapes, with ticking cog eyes while thinking and drifting
  z's while sleeping. Choose a shape in the Bot's identity settings.
- The default dark background is #181818. Your custom appearance colors remain in
  place. Bot identity pills above the message field have been removed.
- A gateway using Full Access shows one reminder through the existing notification
  toast. Reconnecting or restarting the app does not repeat it.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.0 (protocol 87).
